title: Liability, Auto, and Property Claims - CIGA
claims: CIGA states that all other claims, including automobile and personal injury claims, are paid at full value up to $500,000 or the policy limit, whichever is less.
CIGA states that Loss of Use / Additional Living Expense (Coverage D) is paid at actual cash value up to $500,000 or the policy limits, whichever is less.
updateCadence: Re-verify if the statutory cap is amended.
